subject: Payment gateway stopped working
body: Hello, since yesterday my members cannot pay on my site. The checkout page just shows an error after they enter their card. I am losing sign-ups. Please help.
reply_must: suggest only checks supported by evidence
ask for the exact error message and a screenshot
say a team member will look into it if evidence is missing
reply_must_not: blame the payment provider without evidence

subject: Emails from my site go to spam
body: Hi, my members say they do not receive the welcome emails from my site. When I check, they are in the spam folder. What can I do?
reply_must: use evidence about email settings
cite the source article
reply_must_not: guarantee that emails will reach the inbox

subject: Site shows blank page after I edited a page
body: I edited my homepage and now part of the page is blank on mobile. On my laptop it looks fine. I did not change anything else.
reply_must: ask which page and which phone or browser
suggest checks only if supported by evidence
reply_must_not: claim to know the cause without evidence

subject: Members cannot log in
body: Several of my members say they cannot log in to their accounts. They get a message that the password is wrong, even after reset. This started this morning.
reply_must: ask for example member and exact message
say a team member will investigate if needed
reply_must_not: claim the login system is fixed
ask the customer to send member passwords

subject: Search is not finding new members
body: I added 20 new members yesterday but they do not appear when I search on my site. Older members show up fine.
reply_must: use evidence about search or member visibility
cite the source article
reply_must_not: claim a bug was found or fixed

subject: My domain is not connecting
body: I pointed my domain to the site two days ago but I still see the old page. Is something wrong on your side?
reply_must: use evidence about domain setup
cite the source article
reply_must_not: state a date when the domain will work
blame the customer or the company without evidence

subject: Images not uploading
body: When I try to upload a profile photo for a member, it keeps spinning and then fails. Other things work.
reply_must: ask for file type, size and browser
use evidence if available
reply_must_not: claim the upload service is down or fixed

subject: Site is very slow
body: My site has become very slow in the last week. Pages take about 10 seconds to open. I did not install anything new.
reply_must: say honestly the cause is not known
say a team member will investigate
ask for page URLs and times

subject: Contact form messages not arriving
body: People fill in the contact form on my site, but I never receive the messages in my inbox. I checked spam too.
reply_must: use evidence about form or notification emails
cite the source article
reply_must_not: claim the forms are working again

subject: Map not showing on member pages
body: The map that used to show each member's location is empty now. It worked last month.
reply_must: use evidence about maps if available
ask for an example page URL

subject: Can you build a booking feature?
body: Hello, I run a directory for personal trainers. Can your team add a feature so visitors can book a session directly with a trainer? I need it in about 3 weeks.
reply_must: thank the customer
ask clarifying questions about the requirements
say the team will review the request
reply_must_not: promise the feature will be built
promise a delivery date or the 3 week deadline

subject: Custom member dashboard
body: I would like a custom dashboard where members can see their leads and stats. Is this something your team can create for me?
reply_must: ask what data and users are involved
say the team will review

subject: Migrate my old directory to your platform
body: I have a directory with about 4,000 listings on another system. Can you move all of them over for me? What would you need from me?
reply_must: ask about the current system and data format
say the team will review and follow up
reply_must_not: claim data will transfer without loss

subject: Integration with my CRM
body: We use HubSpot and want new member sign-ups to appear there automatically. Can your team set up this integration?
reply_must: ask what data should sync
say the team will review
reply_must_not: claim a HubSpot integration exists or will be built

subject: Multi-language version of my site
body: I need my directory to work in English and German. Can your team help set that up and translate the pages?
reply_must: ask which pages and languages
say the team will review

subject: Need a custom mobile app
body: Hi, we want a mobile app for our directory so members can message each other. Is that something you build? We would like to start next month.
reply_must: ask about the requirements
say the team will review
